## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution

How should it work? Include API sketches, config examples, or architecture notes.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why this one is preferred.

## Use Case

Concrete scenario where this feature would be used.

## Additional Context

Related issues, papers, or implementations in other projects.
